digest.component_or_area: LLM usage logging and repetition detector
propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric only detects back-to-back identical tool call signatures and is blind to cycles of length >= 2, scoring a genuine 4-call cycle as 1 while healthy breadth scores 5
windowed distinct-ratio over trailing 24 tool calls divided by window size reliably discriminates genuine loops (ratio <= 0.50) from healthy runs (ratio > 0.833) and is order-insensitive
the new distinct_ratio_window field must be None when fewer than 24 signatures exist to prevent false positives on short sequences
the named constants REPETITION_WINDOW=24 and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50 must be module-level exports consumed by both the detector and downstream actuators to maintain a shared contract
real agentic loop (253 calls, 30 distinct, one signature repeated 222 times) confirms the windowed metric fires while healthy control (400 calls, 400 distinct) does not
